what: The proposed implement helper fallback counts rejected rows with ^FINDING_N_OUTCOME=rejected, but the existing compact rejected-findings.md lines are emitted with grep -n prefixes.
scenario_or_breakage: When review-tally.env is missing, deferred implement round timing can emit rejected=0 even though rejected-findings.md contains rejected outcomes like 10:FINDING_1_OUTCOME=rejected.
suggested_fix: Make the fallback accept the existing compact format, e.g. ^([0-9]+:)?FINDING_[0-9]+_OUTCOME=rejected$, or read REJECTED_COUNT from another existing env artifact when available.
